source: Jacobson et al., Analysis of the Xedni Calculus Attack (2000), sections 3.1-3.2, simplified lift and reverse-Mestre condition

finite_field_curve.point_law: all ordered pairs of distinct nonidentity E(F_47) points

rational_lift.coordinate_rule: centered integer representative in [-23,23] for each affine x and y coordinate
rational_lift.curve_rule: unique short Weierstrass y^2=x^3+A*x+B through the two lifted affine points when their integer x coordinates differ

auxiliary_condition.condition: coefficients integral at 7, good reduction, rank-two point-incidence matrix modulo 7, and #E(F_7)=3

relation.rational_event: lifted P1+2*lifted P2=O on reconstructed E(Q)

run_cap: complete 1722-pair census; no wall-time performance claim
interpretation: Deterministic r=2 simplified varying-curve lift with one auxiliary reverse-Mestre prime; it does not include CRT over multiple auxiliary primes or curve optimization
